# NOVAX — honest Android apps

> NOVAX is an independent mobile app studio based in Georgia. We build quiet,
> useful tools that do one job well and respect your privacy: every app works
> locally on your device, with no accounts, no hidden analytics and no data
> leaving the phone.

## Apps

- **Files NOVAX** — a file manager that shows every file before anything is
  deleted: storage scan, categories, folder explorer, instant search by name
  or mask, a Trash with restore, an operations log and 12 languages. Works
  offline. https://novaxhub.app/
- **NOVAX QR** — scan or create QR codes and barcodes in a second, even
  offline. History, gallery import, Wi-Fi and contact codes.
- **NOVAX H2O** — a calm water tracker: personal daily norm, gentle
  reminders, day statistics. Coffee and tea count too.
- **NOVAX Habits** — build habits that stick: goals, streaks and reminders
  at your time, no accounts.
- **2067** — an original number-merge puzzle by NOVAX: merge matching numbers,
  reach 2048 and meet 19 — a happy number. 2048 + 19 = 2067 collects into
  your collection while the game continues.

## Principles

- Honest features only: what the card says is what the app does.
- Privacy by default: no accounts, no hidden analytics, your data stays on
  your device.
- Every core feature works offline.
- One-time pricing where the store supports it; free versions are labelled
  clearly and honestly in each store listing.
